new_insert_email_body.title: Team Sync move for hotel review
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

I'll be back from my trip on May 29 and want to discuss the Paris hotel review results with the team. Could you reschedule the Team Sync to May 29, 10:00–11:00 AM? That way we can finalize any hotel change right after the review.

Mark
